scientific_integrity: The coefficient formula and prime-detection property are credited to earlier literature. The zero-dimensional non-atomic limiting law is the claimed new theorem; the proof includes independently reconstructed key steps. Residual implicit general-theorem overlap is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Odd fixed integers \(3\le k<\ell\) only. No effective convergence rate, no full topological-support characterization; the infinite distribution and Hausdorff claims are analytical, not computational.
title: A dimension-zero continuous limit law for normalized prime-detecting Fourier coefficients
